critical_code_review_comments: React strict-mode console warning: 'Using UNSAFE_componentWillMount ...' — comes from a third-party dependency (likely react-helmet, which uses side-effect-full lifecycle methods). Non-blocking but consider migrating to react-helmet-async to silence the warning and gain Suspense/StrictMode compatibility.

Google Maps deprecation warning: 'google.maps.places.Autocomplete is not available to new customers. Please use google.maps.places.PlaceAutocompleteElement instead.' — AddressInput will stop working for accounts created after 2025-03. Plan a migration to PlaceAutocompleteElement before it becomes hard-broken.

AutoTranslator adds a placeholder-translation pass that walks every input/textarea on every 4-second interval scan. For long-form pages with many inputs this could cause extra POSTs to /api/i18n/translate. Consider limiting the walk to nodes that have appeared since the last scan by hashing the placeholder set.

serviceQuotes.js: bathrooms defaults to 1 when the field is blank (Math.max(0, parseInt(details.num_bathrooms ?? 1))). Because ?? treats '' as truthy, an empty string produces NaN → parseInt fallback. The current logic works but explicitly checking for '' would be more robust.

OrderService.jsx auto-updates form.pay_rate whenever marketQuote.total changes — this is correct for the Cleaning fix but means any user-typed pay_rate is silently overwritten by the calculator on the NEXT field change. Consider gating the effect on a 'user hasn't manually edited pay_rate' sentinel.

Two pre-existing non-blocking warnings (react-helmet UNSAFE_componentWillMount, google.maps.places.Autocomplete deprecation) noted in critical_code_review_comments.
